notes: DeepSeek Harness records a genuine configured iteration limit. A direct human setup turn calls create_goal with max_goal_rounds=2. The same-session goal driver then admits exactly two goal-sourced rounds. At the next whole-agent idle point, roundsStarted equals maxGoalRounds, so the driver writes a blocked goal with code round-limit and queues no later round. Transcript assertions distinguish that exact cap hit from model completion, model-reported blocking, or an ordinary turn. RECORD-TIME CORRECTION: the live #1986 recording for 'Assess DeepSeek Harness non-core replay scenarios' showed the exact three-turn state arc ready -> working -> ready -> working -> ready -> working -> ready on one real session. Each inter-turn ready hold lasted about two seconds, so the prior cap_reached phase matched the first short ready interval and failed its 20000 ms hold before it could reach the final ready state. The corrected phases name both inter-turn ready states and both autonomous working states explicitly, then anchor cap_reached after round 2. Transcript assertions prove that the final state follows the actual round-limit block.
